leverage.exposure: An open leveraged position, and it is the only thing on this page that can cost the whole matchday. The offer stands against a smaller balance, so winning it takes the account negative, and a negative balance when the matchday starts scores zero for every player fielded. The window between the auction resolving and the lock is under two hours, on a Friday evening. Selling Amoako now reduces the scramble from two actions to one but does not eliminate it. If Georg cannot reliably act inside that window, the correct move is to remove the offer beforehand and keep the squad exactly as it is - forfeiting a modest points gain is cheap, forfeiting the matchday is not.

binding_gap: The binding constraint is not the spending floor, which leaves enormous headroom, and it is not the squad's shape, which is legal today. It is cash at the moment the matchday locks. The offer already placed exceeds available cash, and no reduction in the bid fixes that, because even the listing's asking price exceeds cash plus the free sale. So the gap can only be closed by selling, the selling can only happen in a narrow window after the auction resolves, and one of the two sales can be done right now for free.

verdict.headline: One live decision, and it is a deadline rather than a price.
verdict.headline_short: One live decision, and it is a deadline rather than a price.
verdict.detail: One live decision, and it is a deadline rather than a price. Georg's uncontested offer on Jordy Makengo resolves roughly two hours before the MD2 lock, and it is bigger than his cash. If it wins and nothing is sold, the balance is negative when the matchday starts and the entire matchday scores zero. The trade itself is good and the news backs it: Makengo is a confirmed starter at left-back for Freiburg and would displace the weakest defender in the eleven. Do the free half of the unwind now by selling Amoako, who has no points record, is not in the eleven, and is losing value daily. Then either be at the phone in the window between the auction resolving and the lock to sell Bernardo, or pull the offer before it resolves. Doing neither is the only genuinely bad outcome available today.

sell.reason: Amoako first and unconditionally: no Kickbase points record at all, outside the eleven under every legal shape, and his market value has fallen by exactly one daily tick since the last run. Sell him back to the market rather than relisting him - the market buys at market value to the euro, confirmed four separate times in this run's feed, whereas his last manager listing sat above the manager-ask cluster and lapsed unsold. Bernardo second, but only after the Makengo auction has actually been won. He is not an availability sale and the briefing should not dress him up as one: Kickbase carries an injury flag on him, but a club statement in late August, a return report days later, a green fitness marker on his profile and three separate previews dated the day before this run all start him at left-back against Dortmund. He is a fit starter being sold because he is the cheapest defender whose value actually closes the funding gap. Widmer looks like the obvious candidate on points and is not: he is worth too little to clear the shortfall, and selling both him and Amoako still leaves the balance negative at the lock.

standing.name: Bernardo

Bernardo's mv rose 7.048.552 -> 7.156.102, exactly his tfhmvt of +107.550, so the realised gain from waiting was 107.550, not the 160.481 the old estimate projected. From here there is ZERO further upside to delaying: no tick can fall before the deadline and the sale price is frozen at 7.156.102 for the remaining ~19,3h. Any future run that repeats "wait for the tick" is wrong. Kickbase buys back at exactly mv with no counterparty, re-measured three more times this run (Blaswich 2.653.917, Tiago Tomas 9.460.597, Awortwie-Grant 1.892.782 all cleared to Kickbase at mv to the euro). After the sale cash is 11.263.624; after Makengo resolves, 2.263.624, positive. Squad dips to 11 (1GK/4DEF/4MID/2ATT, legal as 4-4-2) for the ~19h between the sale and the auction, then returns to 12 with 5-3-2 optimal. Fielded XI 1395 -> 1423, +28: ap 62 out, ap 90 in. HE IS FIT AND STARTING and this is not an availability sale - re-verified independently this run, magazin.comunio.de dated 03.09.2026 gives the Hoffenheim XI v Dortmund as Baumann - Coufal, Kabak, Hajdari, Bernardo - Wimmer, Avdullahu, Burger - Lemperle, Daghim - Hlozek, with Bernardo at LEFT-BACK, Hranac again absent, and only Prass doubtful; he is absent from the Ligainsider Verletzte-und-Gesperrte table (03.09). Kickbase still carries st 2 timestamped 2026-08-31T14:40:12Z, now ~78h stale and contradicted - do NOT notify on it. Alternatives checked and rejected this run: withdrawing the Makengo bid keeps 1395 and forfeits +28 for nothing; selling Widmer instead costs 29 fielded points and does not raise enough; Lokonga is barred as a keeper by HOLD Hj137mo.

standing.name: Bernardo - CONDITIONAL, only after Makengo lands, never before
standing.why: THE ORDER IS THE WHOLE CALL. Sell him ONLY in the window after the Makengo auction resolves in Georg's favour (~16:32Z) and before the lock (18:30Z). Selling him earlier is the trap: squad is 12, SELL S6x53gy takes it to 11, and a second pre-sale takes it to 10 = the -100 penalty if the auction is then lost, which costs 162 points against holding. Conversely, if Makengo lands and Bernardo is NOT sold, cash is -3.273.942 at the lock and the matchday scores ZERO. WHY HIM AND NOT SOMEONE CHEAPER - this is arithmetic, not preference. After Makengo the squad is 13 = 1GK/6DEF/4MID/2ATT; Amoako takes it to 12 and exactly one more sale is possible before hitting 10. That sale MUST be a defender (selling a MID leaves 2 and no legal shape; selling an ATT leaves 1; selling the GK leaves 0) and it must raise at least 3.273.942. Widmer is the lowest-ap defender at 29 but his mv is only 1.833.175 - he does NOT close the gap, and Amoako+Widmer together leave cash at -1.440.767, still negative, still ZERO. So the second leg is the cheapest defender above the threshold, and by ap that is Bernardo at 62 (next are Minjae 110, Matsima 138, ter Horst 143). Resulting eleven 5-3-2: Baumann 129; Matsima 138, Widmer 29, Minjae 110, ter Horst 143, Makengo 90; Nusa 226, Lokonga 44, Onyeka 139; Gregoritsch 195, Guirassy 180 = 1423 fielded ap vs 1395 today, +28, with cash +3.882.160. THIS IS NOT AN AVAILABILITY SALE AND THE BRIEFING MUST NOT PRETEND IT IS. Kickbase shows st 2 / stl [2] on him, but the news refutes the flag: his only real issue was a minor Achilles complaint reported 22.08.2026 (Ilzer), Ligainsider published "Bernardo meldet sich fuer Koeln zurueck" on 28.08.2026, his profile shows the green Fit icon, and three previews dated 03.09.2026 (Comunio, Yahoo, TheHardTackle) all start him at left-back v Dortmund with Hoffenheim's only absentees Prass and Asllani. He is a fit confirmed starter being sold for cash and a better slot. Reject on sight: ligainsider "Bernardo fehlt verletzungsbedingt im TSG-Kader" is 08.02.2026, last season.

standing.name: Amoako
standing.why: REVERSES HOLD Hdcmr4g ("hold through the lock"), now closed. Say this out loud in the briefing. Hdcmr4g was reasoning about RELISTING him to a manager, where his lapsed 1.850.000 ask (+8,22%) sat above the manager cluster ceiling and would lapse again. That is still true and irrelevant: the sale that matters is back to KICKBASE at exactly mv, which is instant and certain (this run measured it four times - Seimen 6.278.094, Fabio Silva 7.928.365, Mueller 2.122.368, Nandja 3.265.757, all sold to the market at mv to the euro). WHY NOW AND NOT AFTER THE LOCK: Georg has a live 9.000.000 offer on Makengo against cash 4.107.522, a gap of 4.892.478 that must be closed inside the 1h58m between the auction resolving (~16:32Z) and the lock (18:30Z) or the whole matchday scores ZERO. Selling Amoako now cuts that gap to 3.273.942 and turns a two-action scramble into a one-action one. IT COSTS NOTHING: he is the only squad player with no Kickbase points record at all, he is not in the eleven (no lo), and at 12 players the best shape is 5-3-2 which drops him anyway - fielded ap stays 1395 either way. He is also decaying: mv fell from 1.709.447 to 1.618.536 since the last run, exactly -90.911 = his tfhmvt, which independently confirms the Hds9v3o finding that tfhmvt is the daily tick and sdmvt is the seven-day sum. AFTER THE SALE the squad is 11 = 1GK/5DEF/3MID/2ATT with exactly one legal shape (5-3-2) and no spare body, which is Hxncgeb's warning and is accepted deliberately: 11 is not a penalty, only fewer than 11 is. DO NOT also pre-sell Bernardo - see SELL S-Bernardo this run; two pre-sales put him at 10 and a -100 if the auction is lost.

buy.reason: Makengo is the only listing on the board worth owning and the only worthwhile one that even resolves before the lock. Everything else either resolves after the matchday has started, or is at or below the weakest defender already in the eleven, or has no points history at all. Two independent current sources put Makengo in the Freiburg eleven at left-back with the alternative named only as rotation cover, his club has no relevant absentees, and he carries no status flag. Do not raise the bid: he is the sole bidder, and the ledger's own calibration shows the instinct to chase the high cluster is what overpaid badly on Onyeka. Do not cut it either - the bid already sits below every contested clearing premium this league has produced, and no cheaper winning bid exists that cash could cover anyway. The price is not the question; the unwind window is.
